listing.name: Delta Cores v1.0 - Just a Bunch O' Deltas!
listing.displayName: Delta Cores - Just a Bunch O' Deltas!

description:
**Adds Delta AI Cores!**

 Do you WANT to do an automated ship only playthrough? 
 Do you HATE the automated ship penalty? 
 The Delta Core is here to help! 

Download: https://github.com/ymfah/Delata-Cores/releases/
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=30126.0

These cluster of Delta level AI cores have no skills   , no value  
But will contribute a whooping **0x** to the automated ship multiplier!
You can find these at any place where AI cores usually drop (stations, probes, etc)
Delta level AIs are not illegal by domain law, and are completely legal! (church and path might say otherwise)
```Can be safely added but not removed from existing games.```
Credit : arthr for the amazing icon and portrait!
